title: Canonical Installment
description: Compact closed installment view for the AdCP compact product lifecycle — one episode, issue, event, rotation period, or creator slot within a collection. Identity is the tuple (collection_ref, installment_id), so both fields are required and the deprecated publisher-domain-free collection_id shorthand carried by the legacy get_products installment is absent. The parent collection's kind indicates how to interpret each installment. Installments inherit collection-level fields they don't override: content_rating defaults to the collection's baseline, guest_talent is additive to the collection's recurring talent, and topics add context beyond the collection's genre.

installment_id.description: Installment ID within the referenced collection. Collection-scoped, not globally unique.

collection_ref.description: Canonical parent collection identity. Required: the canonical surface has no single-namespace shorthand, so every installment names the publisher domain and collection ID that scope its installment_id. The referenced collection MUST be one the enclosing product's collections selectors name.

scheduled_at.description: When the installment airs or publishes (ISO 8601)

duration_seconds.description: Expected duration of the installment in seconds

flexible_end.description: Whether the end time is approximate (live events, sports)

valid_until.description: When this installment data expires and should be re-queried. Buyers should re-query before committing budget to a product with tentative installments.

content_rating.description: Installment-specific content rating. Overrides the collection's baseline content_rating when present.

topics.description: Content topics for this installment. Uses the same taxonomy as the collection's genre_taxonomy when present. Enables installment-level brand safety evaluation beyond content_rating.

special.description: Installment-specific event context. When present, this installment is anchored to a real-world event. Overrides the collection-level special when present.

guest_talent.description: Installment-specific guests and talent. Additive to the collection's recurring talent.

ad_inventory.description: Break-based ad inventory for this installment. For non-break formats (host reads, integrations), use the product's placements.

deadlines.description: Booking, cancellation, and material submission deadlines for this installment. Present when the installment has time-sensitive inventory that requires advance commitment or material delivery.

derivative_of.title: Canonical Installment Derivation
derivative_of.description: When this installment is a clip, highlight, or recap derived from a full installment. Unlike the legacy form, the source is a canonical installment_ref, so a derivative may name a source in another collection.

installment_ref.description: The source installment this content is derived from.

type.description: What kind of derivative content this is
